title: Chen Chi Mei

page_data.en:
No
F. O. REG
No 249
Date 13/4/16.
Shanghai Municipal Council.
12th April 1916-
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL POLICE FORCE）
POLICE FORCE.
(DETECTIVE BRANCH.)

Sir,
Twenty five Chinese revolutionaries have arrived here from Japan during the last week. They were accompanied by twenty three Japanese. They intend to take steps to forment an insurrection at Shanghai and are endeavouring as a preliminary to arm all the members of Chen Chi Mei's 陳其美 party pistols amd revolvers. One of the number who is known as Liu Tsang 劉璋 (probably not his real name) is a man who owns about twenty mines of various kinds in Central China and who has also about ninety mow of land in Nanking. On this property he is endeavouring to raise a sum of money sufficiently large to buy over the troops of the Shanghai garrison. It is reported that he has offered the mortgage to certain Japanese firms who are considering the proposition but who have not given him any definite answer up to the present.
X Chen Chi Mei 陳其美, it is stated, inhabits the upstairs room of a house in the French Concession. He remains indoors all the time but receives trusted visitors who are arranging that he shall be reinstated in the position which he occupied between 1911 and 1913 as Tutuh of Shanghai.

Your Obedient Servant,
McMurchustine
Chief Detective Inspector.

Entered on
M.S. Apr 12 X
Seen by C.S.P.
Copy sent to
S.V.C.
Cm
Captain Superintendent of Police.
page_data.zh:
编号
外交部登记号
第 249 号
日期 1916年4月13日。
上海工部局。
1916年4月12日-
（印章：上海工部局警务处）
警务处。
（侦探股。）

先生，
上周有二十五名中国革命党人从日本抵达此处。他们由二十三名日本人陪同。他们意图采取措施在上海煽动叛乱，并正作为初步行动，试图为陈其美党派的所有成员配备手枪和左轮手枪。其中一名被称为刘璋（Liu Tsang，可能并非其真名）的人，是在华中地区拥有约二十处各类矿山的业主，并在南京拥有约九十亩土地。他正试图以这些财产筹措巨额资金，用以收买上海驻军部队。据报，他已向某些日本商号提出抵押借款，这些商号正在考虑该提议，但截至目前尚未给予其明确答复。
据称，陈其美（Chen Chi Mei）现居于法租界内一处房屋的楼上房间。他终日闭门不出，但会接见亲信访客，这些人正安排让他复任其在1911年至1913年间所担任的上海都督之职。

您顺从的仆人，
麦克默查斯汀（McMurchustine）
总探长。

录入于
M.S. 4月12日 X
警务处长阅毕。
副本发送至
S.V.C.
Cm
警务处处长
